title: Implement Rust Voice Gateway architecture
description:
Implement the architecture accepted in docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md.

Goal: replace the coupled TypeScript bridge with a Rust Voice Gateway runtime core that preserves current/PiBot-style latency within +50ms while supporting reusable frontends, Pi RPC Brain lifecycle, STT/TTS adapters, frontend tools, semantic avatar actions, .foxline configuration, and benchmarkable JSONL traces.

This epic is complete when the Rust gateway can run an end-to-end voice session through the Foxline Codec UI using Pi RPC plus real STT/TTS adapters, with comparable JSONL latency traces against the legacy bridge.

title: Add legacy bridge JSONL latency benchmark
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Instrument or wrap the current server/bridge.ts path so it emits comparable JSONL latency events. This is the benchmark oracle for the Rust gateway.

Acceptance criteria:
- JSONL trace artifact is written under benchmarks/traces/legacy-bridge/ or equivalent.
- Events include mic_frame_received, stt_partial, stt_final, brain_request_start, brain_first_token, tts_request_start, tts_audio_start, frontend_audio_play_scheduled, barge_in_received, and tts_cancel_sent where applicable.
- Benchmark runner can execute a repeatable fixture utterance.
- Documentation states the +50ms allowed deviation target.
close_reason: Done: added legacy benchmark trace mirroring under benchmarks/traces/legacy-bridge, comparable event aliases for mic/STT/brain/TTS/frontend playback/barge-in/cancel events, frontend mic/STT trace hooks, a repeatable WebSocket fixture runner, docs, and just recipe. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo test, bun typecheck, and benchmark runner dry-run; full live fixture execution requires the legacy bridge/Pi/TTS stack running.

title: Implement TTS adapter interface and migrate current Qwen3 worker
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Define the TTS adapter interface and wire the current Qwen3 Python/MLX worker as the first real backend.

Acceptance criteria:
- Adapter interface supports streaming text in, audio_start, audio_chunk, audio_done, error, cancel, and shutdown.
- Current services/qwen3_tts_worker.py can be driven by the Rust gateway without changing its protocol unnecessarily.
- TTS adapter emits latency trace events comparable to legacy bridge.
- Cancel/barge-in latency is measured.
- Backend selection leaves room for rust-mlx, rust-candle, cpp-ggml, ElevenLabs, and OpenAI TTS adapters.
close_reason: Done: added TTS adapter trait and Qwen3 worker backend preserving the current binary protocol; supports speak, audio_start, audio_chunk, audio_done, error, cancel, shutdown, canonical TTS/audio frame mapping, comparable trace event helpers, and explicit future backend names. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo test, bun typecheck, and benchmark runner dry-run.

title: Implement STT adapter interface and parakeet path
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Define the STT adapter interface and connect the current Parakeet/Silero approach as the first real backend.

Acceptance criteria:
- Adapter interface supports PCM input, speech start/stop, partial transcript, final transcript, errors, and reset.
- Parakeet/Silero backend can be selected from config.
- STT adapter feeds the turn manager with evidence frames.
- Latency trace events are emitted for first partial and final transcript.
close_reason: Done: added STT adapter trait and Parakeet/Silero WebSocket backend preserving the current service protocol; supports PCM input, reset, shutdown, partial/final transcripts, speech start/stop VAD evidence, errors, turn-manager frame feed, and comparable stt_partial/stt_final trace events. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo test, bun typecheck, and benchmark runner dry-run.

title: Wire Foxline Codec UI to the Rust gateway WebSocket protocol
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Update the current Foxline frontend to connect to the Rust Voice Gateway protocol instead of relying on the legacy TypeScript bridge path.

Acceptance criteria:
- UI can declare frontend capability profile and required codec capabilities.
- UI can stream microphone PCM and receive TTS audio chunks.
- UI handles session state, turn state, interruptions, debug traces, and avatar actions.
- Existing codec visual experience remains available.
- Legacy bridge path remains available during migration until benchmark parity is reached.
close_reason: Codec UI now has opt-in Rust Voice Gateway wiring: it declares frontend/audio/avatar/tool capabilities, starts gateway sessions, streams microphone PCM16 frames over binary WebSocket messages, plays incoming binary PCM chunks, maps session/error/disconnect lifecycle into the existing Codec UI state, stops gateway mic capture across UI lifecycle actions, and keeps the legacy TypeScript bridge path as the default fallback until parity is proven. Verified with bun run typecheck, cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo check -p foxline-voice-gateway, cargo test -p foxline-voice-gateway, and bun run benchmarks/run-legacy-bridge-fixture.ts --dry-run.

title: Create Rust gateway latency benchmark harness
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Create benchmark tooling that compares Rust gateway traces against legacy bridge traces.

Acceptance criteria:
- Harness runs repeatable fixture conversations.
- Harness computes deltas for STT final, brain first token, TTS first audio, frontend playback scheduling, and barge-in cancel.
- Fails or reports clearly when deviation exceeds +50ms.
- Produces human-readable summary and machine-readable JSON.
- Trace files are stored under benchmarks/traces/ or documented equivalent.
close_reason: Added a Bun latency benchmark harness for Rust gateway parity work. The harness can run fixture commands, compare canonical legacy and Rust JSONL traces, compute STT final, Brain first token, TTS first audio, frontend playback scheduling, and barge-in cancel deltas, write machine-readable summaries under benchmarks/traces, and exit non-zero for missing metrics or deltas above +50ms. Added a Rust gateway fixture driver, just recipes, docs, and changelog coverage. Verified with both benchmark dry-runs, a synthetic trace comparison, bun run typecheck, cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo check -p foxline-voice-gateway, cargo test -p foxline-voice-gateway, and the legacy fixture dry-run.

title: Document monorepo layout and migration plan
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Document the intended monorepo structure and migration from the current bridge to the Rust Voice Gateway.

Acceptance criteria:
- README or architecture docs explain Voice Gateway vs Foxline Codec UI vs Brain vs Persona.
- Docs explain .foxline vs .pi responsibilities.
- Docs explain bundled personas versus project-local personas/loadouts.
- Docs describe how KITT and oqto can connect as clients in the future.
- Migration phases are explicit and avoid breaking the current demo path prematurely.
close_reason: Done: documented Voice Gateway vs Codec UI vs Brain vs Persona boundaries, .foxline vs .pi responsibilities, bundled metadata versus project-local loadouts/assets, KITT/oqto/future frontend client model, and phased migration plan that preserves the TypeScript bridge until Rust benchmark parity is proven. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo test, bun typecheck, and benchmark runner dry-run.

title: Create Rust Voice Gateway crate skeleton
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Create the Rust gateway package/crate structure and first runnable binary.

Acceptance criteria:
- Crate exists for the gateway runtime and builds with cargo check.
- Gateway reads XDG-compliant config with defaults.
- Gateway can start and expose a health/status endpoint or command.
- README/dev docs explain how to run it locally.
close_reason: Done: added Rust gateway workspace crate, XDG config defaults/schema, runnable binary, just recipes, and local README. Verified with cargo check/test and bun typecheck.

title: Define canonical frame model and pipeline traits
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Define the internal frame enum/types and processor/session abstractions for the Rust Voice Gateway.

Acceptance criteria:
- Frame families cover audio, VAD, STT, turn, brain, TTS, frontend tools, avatar actions, lifecycle, errors, and metrics.
- Audio payloads are binary/bytes, not base64 JSON.
- Initial pipeline supports a linear path but does not hardcode direct component-to-component writes.
- Unit tests cover frame routing basics and cancellation/interruption propagation.
close_reason: Done: added canonical frame families for audio, VAD, STT, turn, brain, TTS, frontend tools, avatar actions, lifecycle, errors, and metrics; added a linear pipeline abstraction with interruption-to-TTS-cancel propagation tests. Verified with cargo check/test and bun typecheck.

title: Implement WebSocket frontend gateway protocol
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Implement the canonical frontend transport using WebSocket JSON control frames plus binary audio frames.

Acceptance criteria:
- Frontend can connect, declare capability profile, start/end a voice session, and stream PCM frames.
- Gateway can stream audio frames/events back to the frontend.
- Protocol includes debug trace streaming gated by config.
- No audio is sent as base64 JSON on the normal path.
- Basic compatibility notes for Tauri, browser, KITT, and oqto clients are documented.
close_reason: Done: added WebSocket server shell with JSON control/events, capability declaration, session start/end, VAD hints, interrupts, binary PCM input handling, trace events, and documented client compatibility notes. Full UI wiring remains tracked by fxl-mgvb.12. Verified with cargo check/test and bun typecheck.

title: Implement turn manager with VAD hints and STT evidence
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Implement the authoritative turn-taking component inspired by Pipecat frame semantics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Frontend VAD/noise-gate hints are accepted as hints only.
- STT/VAD events and transcript frames are primary evidence for turn boundaries.
- Gateway emits canonical turn.user_started, turn.user_committed, and turn.interrupted frames.
- Barge-in can trigger immediate local/gateway interruption while awaiting STT confirmation.
- Turn strategy settings include silence timeout, min speech duration, max utterance duration, and barge-in confirmation window.
close_reason: Done: added gateway-owned TurnManager with configurable silence, min speech, max utterance, and barge-in confirmation thresholds; frontend VAD hints remain advisory, STT/VAD evidence emits turn.user_started/user_committed/interrupted frames, and barge-in interruption propagates through the pipeline. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo test, and bun typecheck.

title: Implement Pi RPC Brain adapter with prewarm lifecycle
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Implement the Brain adapter that launches and talks to pi --mode rpc. The gateway must not call LLM servers directly.

Acceptance criteria:
- Gateway can launch Pi RPC for a selected agent/workspace/loadout/frontend capability profile.
- Warm Brain lifecycle supports prewarm, idle timeout, restart, and shutdown.
- Pi process identity is bound to agent, loadout, workspace, and frontend capability profile.
- Voice-only extensions can be passed through explicit --extension flags.
- Adapter emits brain_request_start, brain_first_token, token/text delta, tool call, and error frames.
close_reason: Done: added Rust Pi RPC Brain adapter with identity-bound warm Brain lifecycle, launch construction for pi --mode rpc, explicit voice extension --extension flags, prewarm/idle/restart/shutdown support, JSONL event mapping to canonical Brain frames, WebSocket session binding, and docs. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo test, bun typecheck, and benchmark runner dry-run.

title: Design and implement .foxline loadout resolution
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Define and implement project-local .foxline configuration loading while keeping Pi-specific defaults in .pi.

Acceptance criteria:
- .foxline directory schema is documented.
- Loadouts can select Pi profiles/config and voice-only extensions without duplicating bundled standard extensions.
- Builtin extension references such as builtin:frontend-tools resolve to shipped gateway extensions.
- Project-local .foxline/extensions paths are supported.
- Config supports prewarm/keep-warm policies and STT/TTS adapter selection.
close_reason: Done: added .foxline loadout resolver, TOML schema types, default loadout fallback, builtin and project-local extension resolution, adapter/lifecycle/tool fields, bundled frontend-tools placeholder, WebSocket startup resolution, and schema docs. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo test, and bun typecheck.

title: Implement frontend tool capability negotiation and routing
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Implement two-sided frontend tool negotiation and Pi extension routing through the gateway.

Acceptance criteria:
- Frontend advertises tools/capabilities at session start.
- Loadout declares required and optional frontend tools.
- Effective tool surface is the intersection of loadout allowance and frontend advertised capabilities.
- Missing required tools fail session startup with a clear error.
- Pi can invoke negotiated frontend tools through a voice-only extension and receive results.
- Unauthorized or unadvertised tool calls are rejected.
close_reason: Done: added frontend tool negotiation and routing. Frontend advertised tools are captured from capabilities, loadout required/optional frontend tools are intersected with advertised tools, missing required tools fail startup, negotiated tool events are emitted, frontend tool results become frames, and unauthorized/unadvertised calls are rejected. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo test, bun typecheck, and benchmark runner dry-run.

title: Implement semantic avatar action routing
description:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Add theme-agnostic Avatar Action frames and routing to the frontend.

Acceptance criteria:
- Gateway supports semantic avatar actions such as set_state, set_expression, focus, play_animation, and clear.
- Avatar actions are not coupled to MGS-specific asset names or sprites.
- Frontend can advertise supported avatar action capabilities.
- Codec UI maps semantic actions to existing/future MGS presentation behavior.
close_reason: Done: added semantic Avatar Action routing with support for set_state, set_expression, focus, play_animation, and clear; frontend capability checks; theme-agnostic avatar_action server events; and docs. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo test, bun typecheck, and benchmark runner dry-run.

Initialize foxline as its own git repository if needed, commit the clean tree, and document that future runtime/install/docs work happens in foxline only. Do not bundle model weights unless licensing/size are explicitly handled. Acceptance: ARCHITECTURE or docs/release.md includes platform matrix and artifact layout.

Evaluate whether Silero is still needed once parakeet.cpp streaming EOU is integrated. Test with --skip-setup only if setup has already been validated separately. Verify outputs: assets/generated/mgs_install_manifest.json, assets/generated/mgs_pc/vox-psx-crosswalk.json, assets/generated/mgs_pc/face/manifest.json, agents/*/assets/reference_audio/*_reference.wav, and recursive avatar PNGs. Confirm browser connects to server/bridge.ts, pi-rpc brain starts, parakeet.cpp WebSocket STT receives mic audio, Qwen3-TTS worker speaks, interrupt works, and character switching does not crash the bridge. Acceptance: at least two characters can answer with audio; bridge survives character switch; no legacy eaRS/VoxCPM/pibot-lite path is required.

title: Add foxline doctor script
description: Create scripts/doctor.sh to check publish/runtime prerequisites. It should report bun, uv, tmux, ffmpeg, innoextract, 7zz, cmake/git, pi CLI, parakeet worker binary, parakeet model file, Silero model file, Qwen model/cache availability, generated references/avatars/manifests, and ignored generated paths. It should have clear exit codes and no destructive behavior. Acceptance: scripts/doctor.sh passes after install and gives actionable failures on a clean machine.

title: Modularize server bridge runtime
description: Split the monolithic server/bridge.ts into focused modules: brain/pi-rpc, tts/qwen worker lifecycle, characters/manifest/reference resolution, filler/playback, and WebSocket protocol. Keep behavior unchanged. Acceptance: bun run typecheck passes; runtime smoke test still passes; bridge.ts becomes orchestration rather than implementation of all subsystems.

description: Current filler generation is no longer part of the default all-in-one flow because the old Qwen HTTP service was removed. Either port tools/generate_codec_fillers.py to use the same Qwen worker protocol as server/bridge.ts, or remove/mark --generate-fillers as unsupported in public docs. Acceptance: no documented default command depends on a removed Qwen HTTP server; optional filler flow has a tested implementation if kept.

title: Replace PiBot checkout dependency for parakeet STT worker
description: Foxline currently relies on ~/repos/pibot/native/parakeet-cpp-stt/build/parakeet-cpp-stt-worker. Replace this with a Foxline-owned build path, vendored/native worker, or release binary. Keep parakeet.cpp tdt-0.6b-v3-q8_0 as default for now. Acceptance: setup-deps.sh no longer requires a PiBot source checkout for STT; start-services.sh uses a Foxline-controlled worker path.

title: Implement Hugging Face cache-aware model provisioning
description: Use Hugging Face cache where possible for Qwen and parakeet models, avoiding duplicate downloads. For models/workers requiring explicit file paths, resolve from cache or symlink/copy into a stable Foxline path. Default STT model: mudler/parakeet-cpp-gguf/tdt-0.6b-v3-q8_0.gguf. Qwen default remains Qwen3-TTS only. Acceptance: setup detects already-cached models and does not redownload unnecessarily; docs explain cache behavior.

title: Document alpha limitations and release checklist
description: Update README/ARCHITECTURE with an explicit v0.0.1-alpha status, supported platform assumptions, required user-owned media, no shipped assets, current Python fallback boundaries, default STT/TTS/brain, and known limitations. Include a release checklist covering clean tree, no media scan, typecheck, shell check, install test, runtime smoke test, and attributions.
